meta.title: Contingency Plan
meta.description: A perfectly executed back up plan.

units.rawText: On the surface, at the seaside.
units.displayText: On the surface, at the seaside.

spans.text: On the surface, at the seaside.

units.rawText: The storm from the Weather Simulator has been raging non-stop. The sky is dark and the vortex in the ocean has been still for ten-odd minutes now.
units.displayText: The storm from the Weather Simulator has been raging non-stop. The sky is dark and the vortex in the ocean has been still for ten-odd minutes now.

spans.text: The storm from the Weather Simulator has been raging non-stop. The sky is dark and the vortex in the ocean has been still for ten-odd minutes now.

units.rawText: ...Are we just going to stand by and watch?
units.displayText: ...Are we just going to stand by and watch?

spans.text: ...Are we just going to stand by and watch?

units.rawText: Sol, take a look at the color of the seawater.
units.displayText: Sol, take a look at the color of the seawater.

spans.text: Sol, take a look at the color of the seawater.

units.rawText: The liquid Entropy that was dispersed by the storm is now gathered around the edge of the vortex, and feelers dance languidly upon the water's surface under the darkened sky.
units.displayText: The liquid Entropy that was dispersed by the storm is now gathered around the edge of the vortex, and feelers dance languidly upon the water's surface under the darkened sky.

spans.text: The liquid Entropy that was dispersed by the storm is now gathered around the edge of the vortex, and feelers dance languidly upon the water's surface under the darkened sky.

units.rawText: Urgh... It's all liquid Entropy down there, so there's no point going in, right?
units.displayText: Urgh... It's all liquid Entropy down there, so there's no point going in, right?

spans.text: Urgh... It's all liquid Entropy down there, so there's no point going in, right?

units.rawText: Of course there is! You'll become a delivery meal for the Entropics, Solly~
units.displayText: Of course there is! You'll become a delivery meal for the Entropics, Solly~

spans.text: Of course there is! You'll become a delivery meal for the Entropics, Solly~

units.rawText: What's with that weird tone? You're creeping me out, Anna!
units.displayText: What's with that weird tone? You're creeping me out, Anna!

spans.text: What's with that weird tone? You're creeping me out, Anna!

units.rawText: ...I'm just worried that all of Copley will get wrecked if Hatsuchiri can't stop Demiurge.
units.displayText: ...I'm just worried that all of Copley will get wrecked if Hatsuchiri can't stop Demiurge.

spans.text: ...I'm just worried that all of Copley will get wrecked if Hatsuchiri can't stop Demiurge.

units.rawText: And even if we do manage to escape the Copley Sector, Demiurge still has the source code Croque needs, and this is as close to her as we're going to get!
units.displayText: And even if we do manage to escape the Copley Sector, Demiurge still has the source code Croque needs, and this is as close to her as we're going to get!

spans.text: And even if we do manage to escape the Copley Sector, Demiurge still has the source code Croque needs, and this is as close to her as we're going to get!

units.rawText: The Professor said they've sowed the seeds.
units.displayText: The Professor said they've sowed the seeds.

spans.text: The Professor said they've sowed the seeds.

units.rawText: Frankly speaking, I don't like staking everyone's lives on such a vague statement, but... there's nothing else I can do.
units.displayText: Frankly speaking, I don't like staking everyone's lives on such a vague statement, but... there's nothing else I can do.

spans.text: Frankly speaking, I don't like staking everyone's lives on such a vague statement, but... there's nothing else I can do.

units.rawText: You won't mess around with us when it comes to this sort of thing, right, Professor?
units.displayText: You won't mess around with us when it comes to this sort of thing, right, Professor?

spans.text: You won't mess around with us when it comes to this sort of thing, right, Professor?

units.rawText:
The earth shudders and interrupts Antonina's question.
In contrast, the ocean is abnormally still—or rather, the water is pooling around the center.
units.displayText:
The earth shudders and interrupts Antonina's question.
In contrast, the ocean is abnormally still—or rather, the water is pooling around the center.

spans.text:
The earth shudders and interrupts Antonina's question.
In contrast, the ocean is abnormally still—or rather, the water is pooling around the center.

units.rawText: Hold on tight to me! Don't fall down!
units.displayText: Hold on tight to me! Don't fall down!

spans.text: Hold on tight to me! Don't fall down!

units.rawText: Sol holds on to Antonina and me tightly, doing her best to stay balanced as the ground shakes and trembles. We shuffle bit by bit behind one of the rocks on the seaside.
units.displayText: Sol holds on to Antonina and me tightly, doing her best to stay balanced as the ground shakes and trembles. We shuffle bit by bit behind one of the rocks on the seaside.

spans.text: Sol holds on to Antonina and me tightly, doing her best to stay balanced as the ground shakes and trembles. We shuffle bit by bit behind one of the rocks on the seaside.

units.rawText: ...Looks like she's broken through the barrier. It held out longer than we expected. Not bad.
units.displayText: ...Looks like she's broken through the barrier. It held out longer than we expected. Not bad.

spans.text: ...Looks like she's broken through the barrier. It held out longer than we expected. Not bad.

units.rawText: Professor, the situation on the sea is getting out of hand. We've lost control permissions over the seawater!
units.displayText: Professor, the situation on the sea is getting out of hand. We've lost control permissions over the seawater!

spans.text: Professor, the situation on the sea is getting out of hand. We've lost control permissions over the seawater!

units.rawText: Are we sticking to the plan?
units.displayText: Are we sticking to the plan?

spans.text: Are we sticking to the plan?

units.rawText: Yup. Stick to the original plan and turn it all the way up.
units.displayText: Yup. Stick to the original plan and turn it all the way up.

spans.text: Yup. Stick to the original plan and turn it all the way up.

units.rawText: Understood. Weather Simulator, full power activation!
units.displayText: Understood. Weather Simulator, full power activation!

spans.text: Understood. Weather Simulator, full power activation!

units.rawText: As though in response to the dark moon on the ocean's surface, the clouds in the sky grow heavier.
units.displayText: As though in response to the dark moon on the ocean's surface, the clouds in the sky grow heavier.

spans.text: As though in response to the dark moon on the ocean's surface, the clouds in the sky grow heavier.

units.rawText: The air pressure plummets; hailstones form in the clouds and lash wildly at the surface of the sea, sending huge waves splashing up to the heavens.
units.displayText: The air pressure plummets; hailstones form in the clouds and lash wildly at the surface of the sea, sending huge waves splashing up to the heavens.

spans.text: The air pressure plummets; hailstones form in the clouds and lash wildly at the surface of the sea, sending huge waves splashing up to the heavens.

units.rawText: Persicaria, can you see what's happening out at sea?
units.displayText: Persicaria, can you see what's happening out at sea?

spans.text: Persicaria, can you see what's happening out at sea?

units.rawText: The hailstones are applying a certain amount of suppression, but the Entropics are taking measures against it.
units.displayText: The hailstones are applying a certain amount of suppression, but the Entropics are taking measures against it.

spans.text: The hailstones are applying a certain amount of suppression, but the Entropics are taking measures against it.

units.rawText: The Low-Order Entropics are using themselves as meatshields to mitigate most of the hailstones' destructiveness.
units.displayText: The Low-Order Entropics are using themselves as meatshields to mitigate most of the hailstones' destructiveness.

spans.text: The Low-Order Entropics are using themselves as meatshields to mitigate most of the hailstones' destructiveness.

units.rawText: Demiurge understands the concept of self-preservation. She's using the Low-Order Entropics to protect herself and she's using the operands from the hailstones instead!
units.displayText: Demiurge understands the concept of self-preservation. She's using the Low-Order Entropics to protect herself and she's using the operands from the hailstones instead!

spans.text: Demiurge understands the concept of self-preservation. She's using the Low-Order Entropics to protect herself and she's using the operands from the hailstones instead!

units.rawText: Do as I say and keep stalling for time!
units.displayText: Do as I say and keep stalling for time!

spans.text: Do as I say and keep stalling for time!

units.rawText: The hailstones continue to rain down on the sea, while a wobbling tower suddenly rises from the dark moon.
units.displayText: The hailstones continue to rain down on the sea, while a wobbling tower suddenly rises from the dark moon.

spans.text: The hailstones continue to rain down on the sea, while a wobbling tower suddenly rises from the dark moon.

units.rawText: Countless "Styxes" burst out through the surface of the ocean and rise to the clouds under the cover of the Low-Order Entropics, scattering the clouds by the simple expedient method of charging into them.
units.displayText: Countless "Styxes" burst out through the surface of the ocean and rise to the clouds under the cover of the Low-Order Entropics, scattering the clouds by the simple expedient method of charging into them.

spans.text: Countless "Styxes" burst out through the surface of the ocean and rise to the clouds under the cover of the Low-Order Entropics, scattering the clouds by the simple expedient method of charging into them.

units.rawText: Ack! This is bad... The Weather Simulator is being disrupted!
units.displayText: Ack! This is bad... The Weather Simulator is being disrupted!

spans.text: Ack! This is bad... The Weather Simulator is being disrupted!

units.rawText: What? They can do that from so far away?
units.displayText: What? They can do that from so far away?

spans.text: What? They can do that from so far away?

units.rawText: It suddenly broke, like it got a trojan... Persy's fixing it, but she'll need some time!
units.displayText: It suddenly broke, like it got a trojan... Persy's fixing it, but she'll need some time!

spans.text: It suddenly broke, like it got a trojan... Persy's fixing it, but she'll need some time!

units.rawText: Demiurge puts up no resistance and allows Antonina to pin her to the spot.
units.displayText: Demiurge puts up no resistance and allows Antonina to pin her to the spot.

spans.text: Demiurge puts up no resistance and allows Antonina to pin her to the spot.

units.rawText: She tilts her head and looks toward Antonina with a ponderous expression.
units.displayText: She tilts her head and looks toward Antonina with a ponderous expression.

spans.text: She tilts her head and looks toward Antonina with a ponderous expression.

units.rawText: ...Demiurge is copying my attack methods and hacking the Weather Simulator with signal disruptions.
units.displayText: ...Demiurge is copying my attack methods and hacking the Weather Simulator with signal disruptions.

spans.text: ...Demiurge is copying my attack methods and hacking the Weather Simulator with signal disruptions.

units.rawText: She's much smarter than the first time we met her underground!
units.displayText: She's much smarter than the first time we met her underground!

spans.text: She's much smarter than the first time we met her underground!

units.rawText: I need 10 more seconds... Please give me operand support, Miss De Lacey.
units.displayText: I need 10 more seconds... Please give me operand support, Miss De Lacey.

spans.text: I need 10 more seconds... Please give me operand support, Miss De Lacey.

units.rawText: The sky above the sea clears up briefly, and the tower of Entropics crumbles, crashing back to the ocean.
units.displayText: The sky above the sea clears up briefly, and the tower of Entropics crumbles, crashing back to the ocean.

spans.text: The sky above the sea clears up briefly, and the tower of Entropics crumbles, crashing back to the ocean.

units.rawText: Where the tower fell, Demiurge surfaces, looking around in a daze.
units.displayText: Where the tower fell, Demiurge surfaces, looking around in a daze.

spans.text: Where the tower fell, Demiurge surfaces, looking around in a daze.

units.rawText: So this is the land of freedom... where the light shines.
units.displayText: So this is the land of freedom... where the light shines.

spans.text: So this is the land of freedom... where the light shines.

units.rawText: It's so bright, and it hurts... But, I'm happy.
units.displayText: It's so bright, and it hurts... But, I'm happy.

spans.text: It's so bright, and it hurts... But, I'm happy.

units.rawText: Repairs complete!
units.displayText: Repairs complete!

spans.text: Repairs complete!

units.rawText: The dark clouds gather again, and hailstones fall from the sky amidst a storm.
units.displayText: The dark clouds gather again, and hailstones fall from the sky amidst a storm.

spans.text: The dark clouds gather again, and hailstones fall from the sky amidst a storm.

units.rawText: The Low-Order Entropics gather around Demiurge as meatshields to absorb the impact from the hailstones. The occasional hailstone makes it through that defense, but Demiurge swats it away with a mere flick of her feelers.
units.displayText: The Low-Order Entropics gather around Demiurge as meatshields to absorb the impact from the hailstones. The occasional hailstone makes it through that defense, but Demiurge swats it away with a mere flick of her feelers.

spans.text: The Low-Order Entropics gather around Demiurge as meatshields to absorb the impact from the hailstones. The occasional hailstone makes it through that defense, but Demiurge swats it away with a mere flick of her feelers.

units.rawText: As the incapacitated Low-Order Entropics fall one after the other, the seawater turns a darker shade of purple.
units.displayText: As the incapacitated Low-Order Entropics fall one after the other, the seawater turns a darker shade of purple.

spans.text: As the incapacitated Low-Order Entropics fall one after the other, the seawater turns a darker shade of purple.

units.rawText: I'll try to disrupt their signal! Sol, cover the Professor!
units.displayText: I'll try to disrupt their signal! Sol, cover the Professor!

spans.text: I'll try to disrupt their signal! Sol, cover the Professor!

units.rawText: I'll protect both of you, so just focus on doing your thing!
units.displayText: I'll protect both of you, so just focus on doing your thing!

spans.text: I'll protect both of you, so just focus on doing your thing!

units.rawText: The rate at which the clouds gather is slowing down, but not many of the Entropics have been destroyed.
units.displayText: The rate at which the clouds gather is slowing down, but not many of the Entropics have been destroyed.

spans.text: The rate at which the clouds gather is slowing down, but not many of the Entropics have been destroyed.

units.rawText: Demiurge turns to look at us on the beach.
units.displayText: Demiurge turns to look at us on the beach.

spans.text: Demiurge turns to look at us on the beach.

units.rawText: Demiurge's resistance to signal disruption is rising!
units.displayText: Demiurge's resistance to signal disruption is rising!

spans.text: Demiurge's resistance to signal disruption is rising!

units.rawText: ...There's movement under the sand, get to the rocks, quick!
units.displayText: ...There's movement under the sand, get to the rocks, quick!

spans.text: ...There's movement under the sand, get to the rocks, quick!

units.rawText: Hiss—
units.displayText: Hiss—

spans.text: Hiss—

units.rawText: Don't think you can hide from me!
units.displayText: Don't think you can hide from me!

spans.text: Don't think you can hide from me!

units.rawText: Several Entropics have already rushed onto the beach. We hurriedly climb up the rocks to avoid the Entropics that were burrowing through the sand.
units.displayText: Several Entropics have already rushed onto the beach. We hurriedly climb up the rocks to avoid the Entropics that were burrowing through the sand.

spans.text: Several Entropics have already rushed onto the beach. We hurriedly climb up the rocks to avoid the Entropics that were burrowing through the sand.

units.rawText: Sol swings her twin blades and wipes out all the Entropics that crawled up to attack us.
units.displayText: Sol swings her twin blades and wipes out all the Entropics that crawled up to attack us.

spans.text: Sol swings her twin blades and wipes out all the Entropics that crawled up to attack us.

units.rawText: Urgh... Her attack is still going on. Persy's repair speed can't keep up, I'll help fix it with her.
units.displayText: Urgh... Her attack is still going on. Persy's repair speed can't keep up, I'll help fix it with her.

spans.text: Urgh... Her attack is still going on. Persy's repair speed can't keep up, I'll help fix it with her.

units.rawText: We won't have much time to communicate after this, so the rest is up to you, Professor, and Solly...
units.displayText: We won't have much time to communicate after this, so the rest is up to you, Professor, and Solly...

spans.text: We won't have much time to communicate after this, so the rest is up to you, Professor, and Solly...

units.rawText: I can't hold out much longer on my end either, the volume of signals is too great and I can't crack them all in time!
units.displayText: I can't hold out much longer on my end either, the volume of signals is too great and I can't crack them all in time!

spans.text: I can't hold out much longer on my end either, the volume of signals is too great and I can't crack them all in time!

units.rawText: Professor! When is this "contingency plan" of yours coming!?
units.displayText: Professor! When is this "contingency plan" of yours coming!?

spans.text: Professor! When is this "contingency plan" of yours coming!?
Soon.
Trust me.

units.rawText: How soon is "soon"!? If it takes any longer, we'll have to fall back!
units.displayText: How soon is "soon"!? If it takes any longer, we'll have to fall back!

spans.text: How soon is "soon"!? If it takes any longer, we'll have to fall back!

units.rawText: Why you... Fine, I'll hang in there a little longer!
units.displayText: Why you... Fine, I'll hang in there a little longer!

spans.text: Why you... Fine, I'll hang in there a little longer!

units.rawText: ...If only you could use your silence on the opposition instead!
units.displayText: ...If only you could use your silence on the opposition instead!

spans.text: ...If only you could use your silence on the opposition instead!

units.rawText: Antonina sounds like she wants to go on, but then she suddenly grabs her head and stumbles.
units.displayText: Antonina sounds like she wants to go on, but then she suddenly grabs her head and stumbles.

spans.text: Antonina sounds like she wants to go on, but then she suddenly grabs her head and stumbles.

units.rawText: Urgh... Dammit...
units.displayText: Urgh... Dammit...

spans.text: Urgh... Dammit...

units.rawText: Anna, are you alright!?
units.displayText: Anna, are you alright!?

spans.text: Anna, are you alright!?

units.rawText: Not only is she resisting my decryption...
units.displayText: Not only is she resisting my decryption...

spans.text: Not only is she resisting my decryption...

units.rawText: She's also... trying to... send me signals...
units.displayText: She's also... trying to... send me signals...

spans.text: She's also... trying to... send me signals...

units.rawText: Anna? Hey, Prof, Anna's—!
units.displayText: Anna? Hey, Prof, Anna's—!

spans.text: Anna? Hey, Prof, Anna's—!

units.rawText: I'm fine! Don't let the Entropics catch you off guard!
units.displayText: I'm fine! Don't let the Entropics catch you off guard!

spans.text: I'm fine! Don't let the Entropics catch you off guard!

units.rawText: But—
units.displayText: But—

spans.text: But—

units.rawText: Just then, a golden light suddenly appears in the heavens.
units.displayText: Just then, a golden light suddenly appears in the heavens.

spans.text: Just then, a golden light suddenly appears in the heavens.

units.rawText: A hail of divine gunfire and shells rains down from above, decimating all the Entropics around us in moments.
units.displayText: A hail of divine gunfire and shells rains down from above, decimating all the Entropics around us in moments.

spans.text: A hail of divine gunfire and shells rains down from above, decimating all the Entropics around us in moments.

units.rawText: Hailing Watchtower, Intermediate Sanctifier Love has arrived at the designated Sector, requesting ongoing support.
units.displayText: Hailing Watchtower, Intermediate Sanctifier Love has arrived at the designated Sector, requesting ongoing support.

spans.text: Hailing Watchtower, Intermediate Sanctifier Love has arrived at the designated Sector, requesting ongoing support.

units.rawText: Purgers, commence volley fire. Raiders, prepare to suppress enemies.
units.displayText: Purgers, commence volley fire. Raiders, prepare to suppress enemies.

spans.text: Purgers, commence volley fire. Raiders, prepare to suppress enemies.

units.rawText: Demiurge emits a shriek that shakes the heavens.
units.displayText: Demiurge emits a shriek that shakes the heavens.

spans.text: Demiurge emits a shriek that shakes the heavens.

units.rawText: A golden-haired Intermediate Sanctifier descends from the sky, landing between the rocks and the sea before nodding to us.
units.displayText: A golden-haired Intermediate Sanctifier descends from the sky, landing between the rocks and the sea before nodding to us.

spans.text: A golden-haired Intermediate Sanctifier descends from the sky, landing between the rocks and the sea before nodding to us.

units.rawText: ...You're here at last.
units.displayText: ...You're here at last.

spans.text: ...You're here at last.

units.rawText: Wait, SANCTIFIERS!?
units.displayText: Wait, SANCTIFIERS!?

spans.text: Wait, SANCTIFIERS!?

units.rawText: Whew... At last...
units.displayText: Whew... At last...

spans.text: Whew... At last...

units.rawText: Thank you all for staying behind to provide us with positional data. This region will become a battlefield soon, so please fall back to avoid being caught up in it.
units.displayText: Thank you all for staying behind to provide us with positional data. This region will become a battlefield soon, so please fall back to avoid being caught up in it.

spans.text: Thank you all for staying behind to provide us with positional data. This region will become a battlefield soon, so please fall back to avoid being caught up in it.

units.rawText: After instructing us to fall back, she turns to face the horde of Entropics charging up over the surface of the ocean.
units.displayText: After instructing us to fall back, she turns to face the horde of Entropics charging up over the surface of the ocean.

spans.text: After instructing us to fall back, she turns to face the horde of Entropics charging up over the surface of the ocean.

units.rawText: Large-scale Entropic force detected. Requesting operand support. Refactors, prepare to move in.
units.displayText: Large-scale Entropic force detected. Requesting operand support. Refactors, prepare to move in.

spans.text: Large-scale Entropic force detected. Requesting operand support. Refactors, prepare to move in.

units.rawText: Will they be alright?
units.displayText: Will they be alright?

spans.text: Will they be alright?

units.rawText: Looks like they came prepared. Guess my explanations didn't go to waste. We can relax and leave it to them.
units.displayText: Looks like they came prepared. Guess my explanations didn't go to waste. We can relax and leave it to them.

spans.text: Looks like they came prepared. Guess my explanations didn't go to waste. We can relax and leave it to them.

units.rawText: Are you alright, Antonina?
units.displayText: Are you alright, Antonina?

spans.text: Are you alright, Antonina?

units.rawText: Don't look down on me... I won't get hacked by just this much signal disruption.
units.displayText: Don't look down on me... I won't get hacked by just this much signal disruption.

spans.text: Don't look down on me... I won't get hacked by just this much signal disruption.

units.rawText: But you're still drawing operands...
units.displayText: But you're still drawing operands...

spans.text: But you're still drawing operands...

units.rawText: I'm just trying to crack her incoming signals. I think I understand a bit of what she was sending to the outside...
units.displayText: I'm just trying to crack her incoming signals. I think I understand a bit of what she was sending to the outside...

spans.text: I'm just trying to crack her incoming signals. I think I understand a bit of what she was sending to the outside...

units.rawText: ...Seize...
units.displayText: ...Seize...

spans.text: ...Seize...

units.rawText: Seize...?
units.displayText: Seize...?

spans.text: Seize...?

units.rawText: The envelopment is in place.
units.displayText: The envelopment is in place.

spans.text: The envelopment is in place.

units.rawText: Cleansing commencing.
units.displayText: Cleansing commencing.

spans.text: Cleansing commencing.

units.rawText: Antonina looks past the densely-packed ranks of Sanctifiers in Demiurge's direction. She has emerged from the ocean, like a bird about to take to the sky.
units.displayText: Antonina looks past the densely-packed ranks of Sanctifiers in Demiurge's direction. She has emerged from the ocean, like a bird about to take to the sky.

spans.text: Antonina looks past the densely-packed ranks of Sanctifiers in Demiurge's direction. She has emerged from the ocean, like a bird about to take to the sky.

units.rawText: Powerful emotions assault Antonina's neural cloud through the signals she is receiving.
units.displayText: Powerful emotions assault Antonina's neural cloud through the signals she is receiving.

spans.text: Powerful emotions assault Antonina's neural cloud through the signals she is receiving.

units.rawText: Seize... the light...
units.displayText: Seize... the light...

spans.text: Seize... the light...

units.rawText: Freedom...
units.displayText: Freedom...

spans.text: Freedom...

units.rawText: A trojan... It must have been when we were underground!
units.displayText: A trojan... It must have been when we were underground!

spans.text: A trojan... It must have been when we were underground!
